inputs: NT corpus; target-Greek links; orig/grc.sqlite nodes
test: Greek phrases (one node) with one noun and a numeral: order of the target tokens linked to each
decide: 1 if numeral first >= 80%, 2 if noun first >= 80%, 3 if both >= 20% with n >= 50; else open

test: the same with a demonstrative (type demonstrative)
decide: as GB024
note: needs n >= 50; the NT has few adnominal demonstratives in one node

test: target forms linked to ἡμεῖς (ἐγώ plural)
decide: 0 if one form takes >= 95% (n >= 100); 1 if two forms split by the speaker's inclusion of the addressee
note: the split must follow the context, not the book

test: target forms linked to 3rd-person pronouns by the Greek gender
decide: 1 if masculine and feminine take different forms (each >= 80%)
note: the Greek gender is grammatical: check that the feminine referents are women

test: a class marker (possessive suffix, verb prefix) against the referent's sex
decide: 1 if male and female referents take different markers (>= 80%)
note: needs the referents' sex: Greek gender of persons, names

test: a class marker against animate and inanimate referents
decide: 1 if they take different markers (>= 80%)

test: a genitive noun or personal pronoun next to a head noun: order of the linked target tokens
decide: as GB024 (1 possessor first, 2 possessed first)
note: noisy through word links; retest on units

test: Greek prepositions: is the linked target token before or after its noun's target token
decide: 1 if before >= 50% of prepositions with n >= 100

test: as GB074, after the noun (or a suffix on it)
decide: 1 if after >= 50%

inputs: the verbs segmented by the store's morphs; affix lifts against the Greek features
test: verb prefixes against non-person features (mood, tense, aspect, polarity)
decide: 1 if a prefix has lift >= 3 for such a feature on dev and test, >= 4 stems

test: verb suffixes against the same
decide: as GB079

inputs: as GB079; tone marks if the orthography writes them
test: affixes and marks against the Greek future
decide: 1 if a piece has lift >= 2 on dev and test with >= 20 stems
note: a tendency is enough for 1; note the share

test: verb suffixes against the subject's person and number (intransitive clauses)
decide: 1 if a suffix has lift >= 3 for a person or number on dev and test
note: split by transitivity: a Greek clause with an object role

test: verb prefixes against the subject's person and number (intransitive clauses)
decide: as GB089

test: as GB089, transitive clauses
decide: as GB089

test: as GB090, transitive clauses
decide: as GB089

inputs: verb tokens; links to Greek object pronouns
test: verb suffixes when the token is also linked to an object pronoun
decide: 1 if lift >= 3 on dev and test

test: verb prefixes when the token is also linked to an object pronoun
decide: as GB093

inputs: as GB079; οὐ/μή in the Greek clause
test: verb affixes and marks against clause negation
decide: 1 if a piece has lift >= 4 on dev and test with >= 10 stems

test: subject (role s) and verb (role v) in one clause: order of the linked target tokens
verb last among the clause's linked target tokens; object (role o) before the verb
decide: 1 if verb last >= 75% and object first >= 75%
note: noisy through word links; retest on units

test: position of the negation piece in the clause
decide: 1 if clause-final >= 50%

inputs: as GB107; μή + imperative and μή + subjunctive
test: the pieces of prohibitions against those of declarative negation
decide: 1 if the characteristic pieces differ (each lift >= 4)

inputs: the store's existence and nominal-negation entries
test: negation of existential and nominal predicates against verbal
decide: 0 if different forms are attested
note: corpus count possible: εἰμί / ἔχω with negation

test: adjective (same case) and noun in one node
decide: as GB024 (1 ANM-N, 2 N-ANM)

test: verb pieces against mood (imperative, subjunctive, optative)
decide: 1 if a piece has lift >= 4 for a mood on dev and test

test: Greek finite verbs without a subject word: share of target clauses without a free pronoun
decide: 1 if >= 50% have none
